preservation: Original path order, explicit subpath count, winding, transforms, SVG viewport and paint attributes retained. Invalid polygon representations are kept as original Beziers; no repair, buffer, dropped holes or palette changes.
limits: GEOS preserves topology of the chord-bounded polygon representation. This is not a formal certification of the exact original spline topology at subpixel contacts, nor a shared-boundary simplifier across separate colored paths. No unsupported cubic refitter or generic corner-rounding filter is used.
visual_assessment: Actual Chromium comparison inspected at the same 0.5x full scale and 1:1 crop. Main silhouettes, roots, granite and intermediate shade masses remain close to the previous 48-color sample; some fine edges are straighter/more angular. Original floating trace fragments remain, and this pass does not claim to remove them.
decision: Single fixed-setting pass finished. Raw output remains 1,406,226 bytes (gzip 467,000), above a few-hundred-KB raw target; no further tolerance search, curve refit, retrace, palette experiment or map integration.
